meaning: Exact transport profile per mapped endpoint (method + route template). Native profiles describe the behavior current endpoints actually have and list the gap to the 58.03 target profile; they do not claim 58.03 conformance. A profile is never an authorization grant (58.03 paragraph:19). Observed fields are regenerated from the actual host with scripts/endpoint_profiles.py; profileId and deviations are reviewed edits.

profiles.summary: Anonymous technical liveness/status only. No tenant, user or business data; every response no-store.
BFF session bootstrap and OIDC login redirect. Anonymous by design; the session response issues the antiforgery token later commands must echo (58.03 paragraph:109).
Cookie session termination. Antiforgery required; naturally idempotent, no business aggregate, no command receipt.

Authenticated, server-scoped tenant/company/vessel read. Every response no-store; current authorization on each read; no 304 shortcut. Versions in bodies are opaque native xmin/revision values for later body preconditions.

idempotency.lostReplyRetry: Same key and same canonical body returns the committed receipt outcome re-read under current authorization; no second business effect and a stale expectedVersion does not trigger a second mutation.
idempotency.afterResponseWindowRetry: No response-cache expiry: the durable command receipt is retained, so a retry at any later time replays the receipt instead of re-executing. Receipt retention/tombstone policy is not yet approved (58.03 paragraph:255).

concurrency.missingPrecondition: 400 request validation (expectedVersion is a required body field); not 428

profiles.summary: Authenticated, S1-classified, audited command. Antiforgery and a single Idempotency-Key are required before any business effect; existing aggregates require the body expectedVersion (native xmin/revision CAS); first create is exempt (expectedVersion 0 / absent). Every response no-store.

idempotency.lostReplyRetry: Same key and same canonical body returns the outcome stored in the durable receipt (Idempotency-Replayed: true) after scope and permission are re-evaluated for the current actor; no second business effect. A key reused for another route, action or payload is 409 idempotency_key_reused. Key binding differs per member: parameter commands bind the key tenant-wide, so reuse by another actor is also 409 idempotency_key_reused; DeclareProfileFieldSource and membership commands (including import) bind the key per actor, so another actor presenting the same key runs as an independent command with its own receipt and never receives the first actor's stored outcome.
idempotency.afterResponseWindowRetry: No response-cache expiry: the durable command receipt is retained, so a retry at any later time replays the receipt instead of re-executing. Receipt retention/tombstone policy is not yet approved (58.03 paragraph:255).

concurrency.missingPrecondition: 400 request validation (expectedVersion is a required body field); not 428

profiles.summary: Authenticated, S1-classified, audited command. Antiforgery and a single Idempotency-Key are required before any business effect; existing aggregates require a body expected version/revision fence (native CAS, stale 409 version_conflict); first create is exempt. A replay returns the stored receipt outcome (not a fresh re-read) only after current authorization is re-evaluated. Idempotency keys are tenant-unique for parameter commands and actor-scoped for DeclareProfileFieldSource and membership commands; in both cases another actor never receives a stored outcome. Every response no-store.

idempotency.lostReplyRetry: Same key and same canonical body/route/If-Match returns the outcome stored in the durable receipt after the current actor, vessel scope and action permission are re-evaluated; no second business effect. A key bound to another action, vessel or payload is 409 idempotency_key_reused.
idempotency.afterResponseWindowRetry: No response-cache expiry: the durable command receipt is retained, so a retry at any later time replays the receipt instead of re-executing. Receipt retention/tombstone policy is not yet approved (58.03 paragraph:255).

concurrency.missingPrecondition: 428 precondition_required (If-Match is required on every existing-document command)

profiles.summary: PLAN-1511-5802 controlled document/evidence custody command. Authenticated, S1-classified, audited; antiforgery and a single UUID Idempotency-Key are required before any business effect. Existing documents require If-Match with the opaque native xmin ETag (missing 428 precondition_required, stale 412 version_conflict); document creation is exempt. SERIALIZABLE unit of work: a serialization or deadlock failure (40001/40P01) that is not answered by a stored receipt replay returns 409 version_conflict (retry with the same Idempotency-Key and If-Match), distinct from the stale If-Match 412; a database state-rule rejection is 409 invalid_state. A replay returns the stored receipt outcome only after current actor, vessel scope and permission are re-evaluated. Every response no-store.

idempotency.lostReplyRetry: Same commandId and digest returns the recorded outcome after current ordinary rights are re-checked; no second effect.
idempotency.afterResponseWindowRetry: Outcomes are durable; no response-cache expiry. A different digest for a used commandId is a conflict, never a new effect.

profiles.summary: Enrolled offline device lifecycle and signed replay. Antiforgery required. Replay intent is the body commandId with a durable per-actor/enrollment outcome; daily-offline replay also requires Idempotency-Key equal to commandId, crew replay derives it server-side. Enrollment/renew/key/revoke/lost/cleanup are state-idempotent lifecycle transitions. MaterialConflict outcomes need an explicit parent-command resolution.

idempotency.lostReplyRetry: Same id and same payload returns the existing resource reference; no second row.
idempotency.afterResponseWindowRetry: The resource row itself is the durable dedup record; no response-cache expiry.

concurrency.missingPrecondition: 400 request validation (expectedVersion is a required body field); not 428

profiles.summary: Create-or-confirm by client-supplied resource UUID (or server-staged file id). Antiforgery required; no Idempotency-Key header. An identical retry returns the existing resource; a different payload for the same id is a 409 conflict, never an overwrite.

idempotency.lostReplyRetry: Retry re-applies the same target state; already-applied state is a no-op.
idempotency.afterResponseWindowRetry: No response cache or receipt; convergence is by state.

concurrency.missingPrecondition: 400 request validation (expectedVersion is a required body field); not 428

profiles.summary: Idempotent state transition or recomputation (revoke, refresh). Antiforgery required; no Idempotency-Key header. Repeating the request converges on the same state and never produces a second business effect.

idempotency.lostReplyRetry: Retry performs a new authorization evaluation; no business effect exists to duplicate.
idempotency.afterResponseWindowRetry: Not applicable: nothing is cached or replayed.

profiles.summary: POST that issues a short-lived access grant, an unverified extraction suggestion, or a read-only reconciliation of durable offline receipts (DEV-034). S1 SecurityObservation, audited, antiforgery required. No business aggregate mutation; each call is evaluated against current authorization and may issue a new short-lived grant.
Mapped command that the current scope always denies (S1 AlwaysDenied). Audited 403; never executes a business effect.
